messages:
noah (AE): Heads-up — POC with MediLoop in APAC (ap-northeast-1) is blocked. They pinned model "rdx-xl-v2" but get intermittent "model_deprecated" and 503s. They need deterministic pin behavior for evaluation. Can we triage?

rita (Sales-Eng): Can you share an example request id or a snippet? They also wanted a short Dedicated trial quote (1 week, 1 GPU) and clarity on KMS options.

noah (AE): Example IDs from their dev: ml_req_120fa, ml_req_120fb. They said the SDK sometimes silently routes to "rdx-xl-quant-v2" and outputs lose medically-relevant phrasing. They want either region-local full model or a way to fail fast.

lee (SRE): Looking now. Quick check: rdx-xl-v2 was marked deprecated for new replicas in ap-northeast last month; some legacy artifacts exist but are being GC'd. Error lines show: 
```
{"error":"model_deprecated","message":"rdx-xl-v2 artifact expired in ap-northeast-1"}
{"error":"service_unavailable","code":503,"detail":"no healthy backend"}
```

lee (SRE): The 503s come from the fallback router hitting overloaded eu-central endpoints occasionally. The SDK's fallback behavior can mask the original deprecation.

ana (Platform-SE): @lee is there an option to enforce strict pinning so the client receives an explicit error rather than a fallback? We should document that for sales.

lee (SRE): Yes — set header `x-redwood-strict-model: true` to force deterministic failure on pin miss. Example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "x-redwood-strict-model: true" \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-xl-v2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}] }'
```

rita (Sales-Eng): Good. For the customer, they want to avoid external routing for data residency. What are options for a short-lived local replica?

lee (SRE): Two paths: 1) quick: deploy an ephemeral replica in ap-northeast using existing quantized image (rdx-xl-quant-v2) — fastest but output drift likely. 2) full model replica: requires pulling full weights and a thin infra deployment — longer (approx 6-10h) and needs capacity approval.

noah (AE): They explicitly said quant variant is unacceptable for clinical phrasing. Can infra spin a one-week dedicated pool for 1xA100? What cost ballpark?

infra-bot: quota-check: requested ap-northeast-1:1xA100. Response: capacity likely available. Approval required from capacity-ops. Estimated lead time 5h.

rita (Sales-Eng): Pricing: 1 A100 short trial (1 week) in APAC ~ $2.5k-$3.5k + networking. I'll produce a one-page estimate.

noah (AE): Also need a short security blurb for the questionnaire: BYOK, SOC2, data residency, and audit logs.

tom (Security): Draft: "For Dedicated/Private deployments customers may use customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). Hosted customers use Redwood-managed keys by default; we provide audit logs, TLS in transit, and optional VPC peering for network isolation. We can provide SOC2 attestation copies under NDA." I can tighten language.

ana (Platform-SE): Operational workaround while full replica is provisioned: ask MediLoop to set `x-redwood-strict-model: true` so they will get a clear model_deprecated error and avoid silent fallback. That helps them validate behavior for the POC.

lee (SRE): If capacity ops approves, I'll trigger a deployment and return the deploy-id. Expected time to healthy after approval ~4-6h because we need to stage artifacts.

noah (AE): MediLoop would prefer not to wait if possible. I'll send the strict-header suggestion and the quote. If they approve the trial, we'll proceed with provisioning.

rita (Sales-Eng): Also prepping a short checklist for SDRs if customer chooses to accept quant fallback: 1) sign the delta-notice, 2) run corpus diff with Platform-SE, 3) accept output variance in SOW. I'll attach an example diff report template.

lee (SRE): update: capacity-ops acknowledged the request; pending cost approval. I'll post deploy-id once spun up.

infra-bot: deploy: created deploy xplr-3f2a (rdx-xl-v2) to ap-northeast-1; logs: https://internal-logs/redwood/deploys/xplr-3f2a ; status: provisioning

noah (AE): Great — thanks. I'll keep thread open until MediLoop completes POC. Will share any customer logs or acceptance notes here. :raised_hands:
